Committee: Education Policy
Sponsor: Chambliss
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 03/30/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 297 as introduced allows public charter school facilities, located within the corporate limits of a municipality located within two counties, to be located up to one mile outside of the boundaries of the local school system where the charter exists. This bill will not directly affect state or local funding.
Tim Melson, Chairperson
Education Policy
